advancedValidator.description: Probes all service endpoints declared in the profile and simulates the full AI agent checkout lifecycle — Create → Update → Complete → Cancel.

endpoints.title: Service endpoint probes
endpoints.description: Live HEAD request to each service endpoint declared in the UCP profile. Latency is measured from this server.

mcp.title: MCP endpoints
mcp.description: Probes MCP service endpoints via JSON-RPC initialize + tools/list. Shows the protocol version, server identity, and every tool the agent can call.

a2a.title: A2A endpoints
a2a.description: Probes Agent-to-Agent service endpoints. Checks reachability, agent card presence at /.well-known/agent-card.json, and UCP extension header.

checkout.title: Checkout lifecycle
checkout.description: Simulates the cart → checkout session flow per UCP REST spec: POST /carts → PUT /carts/{id} → POST /checkout-sessions → complete → cancel. 400/422 responses are expected for probe inputs.
